title: Cream Cheese Frosting
equipment: Stand mixer with paddle beater attachment
ingredients: 1 8 oz. block of cream cheese, softeed
instructions: In the bowl of a stand mixer, add butter and cream cheese and beat until creamy, well-combined, and lump-free.
Add vanilla extract and salt and beat on low to combine.
With the mixer running on low, gradually add the powdered sugar until completely combined.
Do not hesitate to stop and scrape down the sides to ensure even mixing.
Use to frost completely cooled cakes and cupcakes.
